title: AuthorDefeatParams
description:
`author.defeat` records a defeating decision. Through contract 1.12 it rules
the existing supporting decision false on the Ref; from 1.13 it appends a
conditional attack edge, so grounded standing restores the target when its
attacker is itself defeated.

claim_id.description: The stable claim id of the stored fact to defeat.

decision.description: The decision that defeats the claim.

defeated_decision.description: The claim's existing supporting decision to rule false.

workspace.description: The authoring workspace whose lorestore is being updated.
